chunks: And in another report, he عليه السلام said:
"Washing the head with al-khiṭmī is a remedy and refreshment."

key_terms.بِالْخِطْمِيِّ: with al-khiṭmī, a cleansing herbal plant
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam
key_terms.نُشْرَةٌ: a remedy, restorative benefit, or refreshment

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about washing the head with al-khiṭmī?
ai.summary: This report states that washing the head with al-khiṭmī carries benefit and serves as a remedy. It reflects the teachings on cleanliness, bodily care, and beneficial hygienic practices.
